|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Quantum Storm]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. * '''PC-E1''' ([[Quantum Storm (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata (Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf)<ref name="sheet23-20240802">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 9 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, July 2024”; file created 2 August 2024). During battle, if your [Hoth] cannon at a related site, may cancel a character's game text here.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Quantum Storm]] (Original). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
